title: Closed-immersion right adjoint before restriction
statement:
Let $i:Z\hookrightarrow T$ be a
closed immersion, with open
complement $j:U\hookrightarrow T$, and let $A$ be a finite ring.
On the small etale sites, the
direct image $i_*$ has a right
adjoint $Ri^!$ on the
ordinary derived categories.
The functor $i^*$ below is the
inverse image.

proof.text: Use the existing arbitrary-Grothendieck-coefficient refinement of the closed-support equivalence in [lem-kun-04ca]: WeilConjectures.SixFunctors.OpenClosed.Supported, mem_essImage_lowerStar_of_isZero_upperStar, together with the Full and Faithful instances in UpperLowerStar.ClosedImmersion. Specialize the coefficient category to ModuleCat A; this works for a possibly noncommutative ring and directly supplies the module version of the first planned step. For the canonical open complement j, the open restriction/direct-image adjunction of [lem-weil-pbc-etale-inverse-image-restriction] has invertible counit, so j_* is fully faithful and j^* of its unit is invertible. Set K(N)=ker(N -> j_*j^*N). Preservation of kernels by j^* identifies j^*K(N) with the kernel of an isomorphism, hence it is zero. The supported-sheaf equivalence implies K(N) lies in the essential image of i_*, and the canonical unit K(N) -> i_*i^*K(N) is an isomorphism by the fully faithful adjunction criterion.

source.place: First proof paragraph; support equivalence and kernel construction, implemented by the stronger proved arbitrary-coefficient library API

proof.text: For every f:i_*M -> N, its composite to j_*j^*N is zero: the open adjunction identifies it with a map out of j^*i_*M, which is zero by [lemma-openclosed-vanishing-lowerstar]. Kernel lifting therefore gives a unique map i_*M -> K(N). Compose with the canonical unit isomorphism K(N) -> i_*i^*K(N), and use fullness of i_* to obtain M -> i^*K(N). The inverse sends g to i_*(g), then the inverse unit, then the kernel inclusion. The kernel lift equation, invertibility of the unit and faithfulness of i_* prove both inverse laws. Naturality in M is proved by mapping through the faithful i_* and cancelling the monic composite of inverse unit with kernel inclusion. Adjunction.adjunctionOfEquivRight constructs the functor with object value i^*K(N) and the sheaf adjunction from precisely this natural equivalence; no arbitrary object is chosen from mere existence.

source.place: First proof paragraph, unique factorization and sheaf adjunction

proof.text: The resulting sheaf-level IsLeftAdjoint instance implies that i_* preserves finite colimits. Its existing right-adjoint instance implies preservation of finite limits, so it is exact; no additional geometric-stalk exactness calculation is necessary. Choose its right adjoint only from the adjunction property, which determines that adjoint up to unique natural isomorphism. The adjunction makes that right adjoint additive. Apply the proved CategoryTheory.Adjunction.mapDerivedCategoryRightDerivedAdjunction to obtain D(i_*) left adjoint to the total right derived right adjoint. This library construction implements the homotopy adjunction [lem-weil-pbc-termwise-adjunction-homotopy] and K-injective derivability using [lem-weil-pbc-kinjective-functorial-existence]; exact-left-adjoint preservation of K-injectives is [lem-weil-pbc-right-adjoint-preserves-kinjective]. The source and target sheaf categories are Grothendieck for ModuleCat A with no commutativity restriction. Finally Functor.rightDerivedFunctorIsoMapDerivedCategory identifies R(i_*) with D(i_*), since i_* is exact. Transfer IsLeftAdjoint through its inverse natural isomorphism. All derived categories and complexes are unbounded, with no constructibility condition.

tool_uses.why: The closed-support equivalence is a generic tool for the sheaf adjunction; no other node of this unit supplies its essential-image assertion.
The natural stalk formula for a closed immersion is the generic tool detecting exactness of its direct image.
Exactness of stalks is the generic exactness test; the exceptional-existence unit does not reprove it.
Conservativity of geometric stalks converts zero stalk homology into exactness; this is a general etale-sheaf tool.
Both restriction of inverse image and the unit formula identify the supported-section kernel; this generic etale-localization statement is not supplied by this unit.
The arbitrary-ring sheaf category is Grothendieck abelian, permitting the existing K-injective existence theorem without adding a commutativity hypothesis.
Functorial K-injective replacement in a Grothendieck abelian category is a generic homological tool for the ordinary unbounded derived category.
Existence and computation of total right derivation from enough K-injectives is a generic localization tool.
An exact left adjoint makes its right adjoint preserve K-injectives, the generic homological step needed here.
The generic lifting of an additive adjunction to homotopy categories supplies the middle Hom bijection.
The generic Hom-into-K-injective calculation identifies the two outer Hom sets.
